{{Quote|The Jundland Wastes are not to be traveled lightly.|[[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]|<ref name="ANH">{{Film|IV}}</ref>}}
The '''Jundland Wastes''', also simply known as the '''Jundland''', were a dry, hot, and rocky region that was located on the desert [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], between the [[Northern Dune Sea/Legends|Northern Dune Sea]] and the [[Western Dune Sea/Legends|Western Dune Sea]]. In the native parlance, "Jundland" meant "No Man's Land."
[[File:Jundland_Wastes_at_dusk.png|thumb|left|180px|Jundland Wastes at dusk]]
This remote area primarily consisted of a number of canyons that wound their way around a number of large mesas and was situated near the [[Dune Sea/Legends|Dune Sea]]. The nomadic [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Tusken Raiders]] and the Jundland Waste [[Womp rat/Legends|womp rat]] inhabited the area. Several layers of rocks within the Wastes were tilted, indicating graben formations. They also contained magnetic deposits which obscured [[Sensor/Legends|sensors]].

==History==
{{Quote|No more adventures. I'm not going that way.|[[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] to [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]]|<ref name="ANH" />}}
During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], the Jundland Wastes were effectively split into two different territories. The region to the north of the canyon known as [[The Wound]], including [[Dreviad Outpost]], [[Outpost Salara]], [[Outpost Largona]], and [[Camp Karnori|Espelar]], was allied with the Republic, while the southern region, including [[Mos Anek]], [[Outpost Rennar]], and [[Outpost Varath]], was under Imperial occupation.<ref name="TOR" />

[[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] [[Mission to rescue Shmi Skywalker Lars/Legends|massacred]] a [[Unidentified Tusken village/Legends|Tusken Raider village]] in the Jundland Wastes during the [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Crisis]].<ref name="AotC" /><ref name="ItWoSWAotC" />

Two decades later, [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] met [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] here in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]] after being attacked by Tusken Raiders.<ref name="ANH" /><ref name="ItWoSWT" /> After the fight, Tusken Raiders remained terrified by Obi-Wan Kenobi's apparition and were convinced that the the spirit of a great and ancient [[Krayt dragon/Legends|krayt dragon]] was haunting the area.<ref name="SWG:SR">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Shock Rods|Tatooine}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The real-world location for the Jundland Wastes is [[Sidi Bouhlel]] in [[Tunisia]]; the resulting film stock was edited together with pick-up shots from [[Death Valley]] in California.
